title: curia ingest document
description: One JSON document per turn, written to the stdin of `curia ingest` (at most 64 KiB). Curia refuses a document that is not one JSON object, is too large, has another schema_version or a bad session_id. A bad optional field is dropped alone and the rest is stored. An absent or null field changes nothing and ingest never clears a stored value. Unknown fields are ignored. model, context_used and context_max are read and ignored: hooks and the transcript own them. Time bounds are checked against the clock when the document is read: at from now - 24h to now + 1m; cache_expires_at from now - 7d to now + 2h; resets_at from now - 1h to now + 8d (else the reading is kept without a reset time). Source of truth: docs/superpowers/plans/2026-11-13-curia-plan-5-cost-and-integrations.md section 4.2.

resets_at.description: When the window resets: RFC 3339, or a number of Unix seconds.

session_id.description: Required. The Claude Code session id; the key the cost and cache values are stored under.

at.description: When the reading was taken, RFC 3339. Default: now.

cost_usd.description: The session's running cost in US dollars.

cache_expires_at.description: When the session's prompt cache goes cold, RFC 3339.

cache_rebuild_usd.description: What rebuilding the cold cache would cost, in US dollars.

rate_limits.description: The account's usage windows. One usage sample is stored per window.
